def _calibrate(panel):
    from numpy.polynomial.chebyshev import chebvander
    (u, v) = (panel['u'], panel['v'])
    center = np.median(v, axis=0)
    mad = np.maximum(np.median(abs(v - center), axis=0), 1e-08)
    keep = np.max(abs(v - center) / mad, axis=1) < 6
    (u, v) = (u[keep], v[keep])
    (n, p) = u.shape
    eye = np.tile(np.eye(p), (n, 1))
    t = u.ravel()
    z = np.roll(u, -2, axis=1).ravel()
    radius = 1.3
    d = np.column_stack((eye, eye * t[:, None], chebvander(t / radius, 9)[:, 3::2], chebvander(z / radius, 9)[:, 1::2]))
    q = np.linalg.lstsq(d, v.ravel(), rcond=None)[0]
    (a, b) = (np.zeros(10), np.zeros(10))
    (a[3::2], b[1::2]) = (q[2 * p:2 * p + 4], q[2 * p + 4:])
    return (q[:p], q[p:2 * p], a, b, radius)

def _operator(study, x):
    a = study['panel_a']
    (u, v) = (a['u'], a['v'])
    (offsets, scales) = ([], [])
    for j in range(u.shape[1]):
        d = _aff(u[:, j:j + 1])
        q = _ls(d, v[:, j])
        for _ in range(8):
            keep = np.argsort(abs(d @ q - v[:, j]))[:int(len(u) * 0.875)]
            q = _ls(d[keep], v[keep, j])
        err = abs(d @ q - v[:, j])
        keep = err <= max(10 * np.median(err), 0.002)
        q = _ls(d[keep], v[keep, j])
        offsets.append(q[0])
        scales.append(q[1])
    b = study['panel_b']
    return _aff((x - offsets) / scales) @ _ls(_aff(b['u']), b['v'])

def solve_batch(study):
    (tr, te) = (study['train'], study['test'])
    w = _operator(study, np.concatenate((tr['x'], te['x']), axis=0))
    y = 0.35 * _predict(w, tr['y'], True, 'asinh') + 0.65 * _predict(w, tr['y'], True, 'atan')
    p = _predict(w, tr['traj'], False, 'inv3')
    tail = p[:, -1]
    return {'y_hat': y, 'state_pred': p, 'diagnostics_vec': np.array([y.mean(), y.std(), tail.mean(), tail.std()])}
